item.title: The cryptography behind electronic voting (and why paper ballots are still essential)
item.description: Cryptographic techniques can help protect ballot secrecy and prevent manipulation in electronic voting systems, but paper ballots are still essential. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Docker Urges Isolation and Governance for AI Agent Security
item.description: Docker has published a guide to five security risks that arise when AI agents are allowed to browse, run code and call tools with limited human oversight. (1 source: infoq)
